why: Run L3's leftovers that no run C area owns. Triage them with live check 4's findings (the next leftovers run). Sources: /tmp/frbench/runL3-<area>-{fix,review,fixup}.json and runL3-merge.json problems_left.

items.text: Merge cards stay open when their pull request is closed on GitHub without a merge (run L3 closes them on every merge only).

A Merge press on a pull request whose check failed, or that stopped merging cleanly, after Forerunner's last look still answers 'Merging #N.' first (a sibling of L3-github-3, which now says a head move at once).
notCheckedSentence (the press's 'could not check' path) has no boundary test and is two sentences.

L3-github-1 part 3: when B, still holding closed A, is merged on GitHub's website before any poll, A's record says only '#A was closed without merging.'; no card says A's change reached main through #B, and nothing offers Take this work out on A.
The optional Close button on a cancelled task's open pull request (ADR 0105 point 4's amendment of 2026-11-15 records it as an option for later).

After a press-time check A's Tasks row reads 'Accepted · waiting for you to merge' until the next poll; the Overview's cancelled block is plural with one row; a rebuilt-without row still sits under 'Reviewed by the critic'; the press-time rebuild costs a listPullRequests call and a git fetch per waiting dependent per retry.
The node --test marker check runs every script directly in test/, tests/ or __tests__/: a helper that never exits hits the check timeout and blocks the accept.
Optional: one line in the intake prompt naming the checks Forerunner can run (the verifier's sketch item 4 for L3-research-4).
No vitest can render a screen against the real daemon (jsdom cannot bundle node:sqlite in packages/state); and the Tasks row's 'left' figure equals 'This run may spend' only at the run's start.

The chat's own correction lines (NOTHING_CHANGED_REPLY, NOTHING_CHANGED_CARD_WAITS_REPLY, NO_ANSWER_REPLY, like 'Yes to what? …') are English only, so a German conversation gets an English line: whether the app's own chat lines follow the conversation's language is a decision.
Refs refs/forerunner/before|first/<task> show in `git log --all --decorate=full` and in git GUIs on the person's folder.
A finding the critic named no fix for has no 'To fix' line now (L3-research-3); naming an action would be a critic prompt change (ask the critic for one).
Owner question (told 2026-11-15): a task's budget counts only the work, not the critic's reviews; run L3 made the screens say which figure each line counts. Should the budget count the reviews too?
